goals.title: Project Goals
goals.subtitle: Define your transformation vision
goals.beDescription: Who do you need to BE?
goals.beExample: Example: Be a disciplined and focused person
goals.doDescription: What do you need to DO?
goals.haveDescription: What do you need to HAVE?
goals.beTip1: Start with 'I am someone who...' - write in present tense to embody the identity
goals.beTip2: Focus on character traits, mental habits, and ways of being
goals.beTip3: Describe how you'd show up and feel after the transformation
goals.doTip1: Start with 'I will...' - be specific about actions and frequency
goals.doTip2: Include concrete measures where possible (time, amount, frequency)
goals.haveTip1: Start with 'I will have...' - describe tangible outcomes and achievements
goals.haveTip2: Focus on verifiable milestones and specific results
goals.beExample1: I am someone who communicates openly and honestly in all my relationships.
goals.beExample2: I am someone who expresses emotions openly and creates safe spaces for vulnerability in my relationships.
goals.beExample3: I am someone who truly listens to understand, not just to respond, making others feel heard and valued.
goals.doExample1: I will practice active listening for 15 minutes daily with my partner.
goals.doExample2: I will schedule weekly date nights without distractions.
goals.doExample3: I will express gratitude to my loved ones every day.
goals.haveExample1: I will have resolved 3 major conflicts with compassion.
goals.haveExample2: I will have deepened trust with 5 close relationships.
goals.haveExample3: I will have created 10 meaningful memories with family.
goals.minimumGoals: You need at least 3 BE, 3 DO, and 1 HAVE goals to continue

intro.title: Life Wheel Assessment
intro.subtitle: 10 Questions. 10 Minutes. Your Starting Point.
intro.permanentWarningTitle: This assessment is permanent and cannot be retaken
intro.permanentWarningDesc: Your results become your baseline for all future transformations.
intro.answerHonestlyTitle: Answer honestly - this is just your baseline. You'll improve from here.
intro.answerHonestlyDesc: This assessment creates your starting point across 6 life areas. There are no wrong answers - we're measuring where you are now, not where you should be. Your transformation journey begins with this honest snapshot.
intro.yesNoFormat: Simple YES/NO format for honest answers
intro.instantScoringDesc: Each area gets a score from 0-10 based on your responses
intro.identifiesFocusDesc: Your lowest scoring area becomes your first transformation priority
intro.beHonestDesc: Your authentic answers create the most effective transformation plan
intro.thinkRecentDesc: Base answers on your last 3-6 months, not your best or worst days
intro.noJudgmentDesc: Low scores aren't failures - they're opportunities for growth
intro.startingLineDesc: Every transformation journey needs a clear beginning point
intro.step1: Your personalized Life Wheel is generated
intro.step2: We identify your priority area for transformation
intro.step3: You can create your first 90-day Project
intro.timeInvestmentDesc: Most people complete this assessment in 8-12 minutes. Take your time - there's no rush.
intro.cannotGoBack: You cannot go back once started
intro.cannotGoBackDesc: This assessment is designed to capture an honest moment in time. When you begin, commit to completing it and move forward. You'll be able to retake or reassess past this first baseline.
intro.allCompletedDesc: Congratulations! You've completed your Life Wheel assessment. Now you can view your personalized Life Wheel and start creating projects in your lowest scoring areas.

questions.thinkTypicalWeek: Think about your typical week. Are you able to disconnect from work and enjoy personal time without stress?
